description: Header file declaring functions and structures related to upload pack operations in a version control system.

methods.name: upload_pack
methods.description: Initiates an upload pack with specified flags for advertise_refs and stateless_rpc, and a timeout value.

methods.name: upload_pack_v2
methods.description: Handles upload pack operation for a given repository and request packet.

methods.name: upload_pack_advertise
methods.description: Prepares and advertises repository references via the provided string buffer.
